text: 2026-08-03 next slice: prepared response policies currently stop at PreparedFitBlockInput and are discarded before FitBlock/FmriFitResult/AnalysisProvenance. Carrying immutable ResponsePreparationProvenance through block, public result, manifest, and JVM sidecar should make applied/rejected/deferred policy meaning inspectable at inference/export, while also fixing prepared chunk interpreters that currently rebuild raw responses instead of the prepared response.
